scope.supported_SWAP_bottom_boundary: prescribed lower-boundary head only, corresponding to qualified bottom mode 5 ownership

interface_quantities.external_head_domain: common hydraulic-head datum in metres, explicitly mapped by the coupling contract
interface_quantities.SWAP_native_boundary_input: qualified prescribed bottom-head representation, with explicit unit/datum mapping outside solver physics
interface_quantities.q_SWAP_sign: positive water leaving SWAP through the bottom interface
interface_quantities.q_GW_sign: positive water leaving groundwater through the same interface

accuracy_policy.application_contract: existing coupling_application_accuracy_contract_t and qualified external adapter boundary
accuracy_policy.H_app: external, positive, finite, qualified and provenance-bound
accuracy_policy.A_temporal: external, positive, finite, qualified and provenance-bound
accuracy_policy.H_interface_tol: required explicit coupling convergence policy input with immutable provenance; no default
accuracy_policy.prohibited_equivalence: H_interface_tol must not silently be equated to the Richards temporal-indicator budget, predictor perturbation, solver tolerance or physical/regulatory threshold
accuracy_policy.compatibility_rule: A production run must prove the selected H_interface_tol is governed consistently with the active application/temporal accuracy contract. A later owner workunit must qualify the exact allocation/binding rule before production admission.

coupling_window.delta_T: t1 - t0; may be subdaily, non-midnight, greater than one day, or adaptively changed by an outer controller
coupling_window.checkpoint_rule: capture committed SWAP and groundwater-side states at t0 before any predictor trial
coupling_window.physical_origin_rule: predictor and corrector both start from the same committed t0 checkpoints
coupling_window.warm_start_rule: worker-local numerical guesses may be reused; candidate physical states never become the origin of another unaccepted trial
coupling_window.commit_rule: commit both sides exactly once only after the accepted corrector satisfies every gate
coupling_window.rollback_rule: any rejected or failed trial restores/retains both committed t0 states and publishes no accepted exchange

required_capabilities: checkpoint committed groundwater state at t0
provide or derive a predictor groundwater boundary head for [t0,t1]
evaluate a groundwater trial using the exact opposite interface transfer
return groundwater interface head on the common datum
optionally return a qualified groundwater response sensitivity
commit an accepted groundwater trial exactly once
forbidden: SWAP kernel dependence on MODFLOW types
file parsing or path ownership in the SWAP kernel
groundwater state mutation by a rejected coupling trial

predictor.origin: committed t0 state on both sides
predictor.boundary: groundwater-side predictor head mapped explicitly to the prescribed SWAP bottom-head control
predictor.SWAP_action: run one complete transactional SWAP interval trial on a clone of committed t0 state
SWAP_outputs: bottom/interface head on the common contract domain
predictor.groundwater_action: evaluate paired groundwater trial using q_GW = -q_SWAP from the same groundwater t0 checkpoint
predictor.result: predictor interface residual and response information; predictor is never committed

corrector.origin: same committed t0 checkpoints as predictor
corrector.candidate_derivation: coupling response operator derives one corrected interface candidate from predictor residual plus qualified SWAP and groundwater response information
corrector.tangent_preference: use qualified whole-window composition of accepted interface sensitivities when available
corrector.finite_difference_role: reference or bounded fallback qualification only; never a structural requirement for the normal production path
corrector.SWAP_action: run one corrected transactional SWAP interval trial
corrector.groundwater_action: run the paired corrected groundwater trial with exact opposite interface transfer
corrector.publication: only the corrected candidate may become the accepted coupled result

all_required: SWAP mass accounting complete with no missing contribution
q_GW assigned exactly as -q_SWAP on the authoritative accepted transfer
interface mass ledger closes exactly by construction
all interval, lineage, candidate and commit provenance agree

bounded_cost_policy.failure_recommendation: rollback and return a diagnosable retry-with-smaller-window request to the outer runtime; any smaller interval is a new coupling window with a fresh checkpoint protocol
bounded_cost_policy.internal_SWAP_transaction_retries: remain governed independently by the qualified SWAP transaction/numerical policy and are reported separately

failure_behavior.on_predictor_failure: discard both trials, retain committed t0, book no interface transfer, return failure diagnostics
failure_behavior.on_corrector_failure: discard both candidates, retain committed t0, book no interface transfer, recommend a smaller new coupling window when policy permits
failure_behavior.on_head_nonconvergence: same fail-closed rollback behavior; no relaxed mass or silent uncoupled fallback
failure_behavior.on_mass_or_provenance_failure: hard reject; no retry may convert incomplete or inconsistent mass into an accepted result
failure_behavior.fallback_modes: must be explicit, separately qualified and diagnosable; deep-vadose is not a fallback for direct coupling

mass_ledger.authoritative_SWAP_mass: canonical accepted SWAP interval mass accounting
mass_ledger.authoritative_interface_transfer: accepted corrected q_SWAP integrated over the accepted coupling interval and tile area basis
mass_ledger.groundwater_pair: exact negative of the authoritative SWAP transfer
mass_ledger.cell_aggregation: q_cell = sum(fraction_i * q_i) for the complete deterministic tile composition

required_per_window: predictor and corrector heads, fluxes and head residuals
application H_app/A_temporal materialization status and H_temporal_budget
interface sensitivity availability, provenance, covers-requested-window flag and whether used
groundwater response sensitivity availability and whether used
SWAP transaction calls, internal retries, nonlinear iterations, Jacobian builds and linear solves
coupling corrector count and requested smaller-window fallback status
SWAP mass completeness/residual and interface mass ledger

persistent: committed SWAP physical state through the existing SWAP restart contract
committed groundwater-side state through its owner adapter/model restart contract
coupling lineage/revision and mapping-version identifiers required to prove continuation
accepted cumulative/interface ledger state only if needed to continue balance reporting
not_persistent: predictor or rejected corrector physical states
restart.qualification: continuous run and split/restart run must give identical accepted states, accepted interface transfers and deterministic diagnostics within the qualified deterministic contract

MultiSWAP.relation: one groundwater cell may own one or more surface tiles; no 1:1 requirement
MultiSWAP.fractions: complete cell fractions sum to one or fail closed
MultiSWAP.aggregation: surface-fraction-weighted interface transfer on groundwater-cell area basis
MultiSWAP.groundwater_head: groundwater-cell head is supplied through the typed interface; SWAP never knows its cell fraction
MultiSWAP.cell_atomicity: for the restricted profile, all active direct-coupled SWAP tiles participating in one groundwater-cell window must satisfy their gates before that cell exchange commits; one failing tile rejects that cell-window composition
MultiSWAP.cross_cell_isolation: failure of one groundwater-cell coupling transaction must not mutate or reject already independent cells
MultiSWAP.batching: columns may remain grouped by compatible SWAP execution template; coupling metadata must not create one heavyweight solver per logical column

deep_vadose_seam.future_owner: external transfer-zone component composed by runtime/coupler
deep_vadose_seam.future_contract: dS/dt = q_SWAP_bottom - q_gw and q_gw = S/tau or another separately qualified conservative transfer model
deep_vadose_seam.transition_requirement: stored water must be explicitly retained/transferred/discharged so no water disappears or is double counted
deep_vadose_seam.restricted_direct_profile_behavior: TRANSFER_ZONE mapping is rejected as out of scope, not silently treated as direct recharge

admission_blockers: F-CI49 must canonically admit the definitive F-KT15 accepted interface-result and sensitivity transport postimage
